description: This file defines the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class in PHP, implementing CRUD operations for managing employee supervisor relationships within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting supervisor associations, along with necessary validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPI
classes.description: A PHP class implementing CRUD endpoints for managing employee supervisor relationships within the OrangeHRM platform, including retrieval, addition, update, and deletion of supervisors, with integrated validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee supervisor record based on employee number and supervisor ID, returning the data wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all supervisors for a specified employee, supporting sorting and pagination, returning the results in an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a new supervisor for an employee by creating a ReportTo entity and returning it as an EmployeeSupervisorModel wrapped in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: setSupervisorParams
methods.description: Sets properties on a ReportTo entity based on request body parameters, preparing it for saving.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the reporting method of a specified employee-supervisor relationship, persisting changes, and returning the updated data.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and supervisor ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring provided employee and supervisor IDs are accessible.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation for the getAll method, including employee ID access and pagination/sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules required for creating a supervisor relationship.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified supervisor relationships for an employee based on IDs provided in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation, including employee ID and supervisor IDs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee supervisor record with a new reporting method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method, requiring a valid supervisor ID and reporting method ID.
